title: Quarterly commit & contingency plan: Hosted API + Model Catalog (Model-swap runway)
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Produce a defendable quarterly commit plan for the hosted API model catalog with an explicit 'model-swap runway' (mechanics and calendar for safe rotating, promoting, and rolling back model variants). This ticket captures the cross-functional milestones, contingency windows, staffing expectations (holidays and on-call coverage), and decision criteria for committing model lineup changes into the Q2 release lanes. Scope covers model selection gates, canary scheduling, runtime dependency checks, cost impact forecasts, and customer communication cadence.
acceptance_criteria: Release lanes (Tier A/B/C) defined and ratified by Eng/Product/Support
Model-swap runway document published with step-by-step operator playbook
Canary schedule (time windows + fallback) defined for each Tier A model
Cross-team dependencies enumerated (runtime, infra, billing, legal) and owners assigned
Contingency budget and burst plan approved by Finance
Smoke tests and quality gates for promoted models (prompt set pass rates) >= agreed thresholds
Customer-facing change calendar published and synced with growth/support teams
milestones: 2026-02-20 Draft runway & release lanes published for review
2026-02-26 Dependency signoff (runtime kernels, quant profiles, infra quotas)

risks: Runtime incompatibility: last-minute kernel regressions could force model hold. Mitigation: freeze kernel updates 48h before canary and run targeted perf/accuracy suite.
Staffing gaps around regional holidays could delay rollouts. Mitigation: publish on-call assignment and require partner teams to nominate backups.
Unexpected cost delta from new model quantization settings. Mitigation: pre-launch cost profiling and a 48h burst budget for rollback.
Legal/compliance flags for a model's training data provenance. Mitigation: pre-check standard legal checklist and include legal signoff in release lane gating.
